items.title: DexCom (DXCM) Stock Sees Fair Value Lift After Analyst Target Increases
items.summary: DexCom’s fair value estimate has shifted from US$85.24 to US$91.64, marking a moderate uplift in the price target range currently referenced for the stock. This move lines up with recent analyst commentary, where many firms are reaffirming or raising targets, while a smaller group trims expectations on valuation concerns and growth assumptions. items.title: DXCM Q2 Deep Dive: Expanded Access and Product Updates Drive Growth
items.summary: Medical device company DexCom (NASDAQ:DXCM) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 13.1% year on year to $1.31 billion. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $5.22 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.70 per share was 15.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
